info.text:
VPN companies want two years of your money on day one.

Example with NordVPN Basic prices reported in 2026: $12.99 x 24 months = $311.76, vs a 2-year deal billed $81.36 upfront that renews higher.
Kape Technologies (ExpressVPN, CyberGhost, Private Internet Access) said 86.8% of its 2022 revenue was recurring; revenue grew from $66.1M in 2019 to $623.5M in 2022.
Kape also bought the review sites vpnMentor and Wizcase in 2021. NordVPN's affiliate program reportedly pays 40% on new 2-year plans.
In 2023 an Australian court fined two Meta units A$20M over misleading claims about the free Onavo VPN app.

Sources: Kape FY2019-FY2022 results, Tom's Guide and security.org NordVPN pricing (2026), affiliate program directories, Federal Court of Australia/ACCC (2023).
News and education, not financial advice.
